rungs.title: Admin Assistant
rungs.summary: Learning how the office, the systems and the paperwork run.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the company's tools, policies and who does what.
rungs.delivery: Handles routine requests, records and scheduling accurately.
rungs.leadership: Is the friendly, reliable first point of contact.

rungs.title: Administrator
rungs.summary: Runs office and company administration on their own.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in the company's systems, onboarding, procurement and records.
rungs.delivery: Owns recurring admin processes and fixes the ones that waste time.
rungs.leadership: Coordinates with every team and keeps promises about turnaround.

rungs.title: Senior Administrator
rungs.summary: Owns administration processes and trains others.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in policy, data protection and vendor management.
rungs.delivery: Owns administration across teams and improves it with data.
rungs.leadership: Trains and supports colleagues and builds relationships with suppliers.

rungs.title: Operations Manager
rungs.summary: Runs the operations of the company.
rungs.knowledge: Connects people, suppliers, finance and compliance.
rungs.delivery: Owns operations: processes, vendors, budgets and risk.
rungs.leadership: Manages a team and works with every department head.

rungs.title: Head of Operations
rungs.knowledge: Sees the company as a system and finds where it leaks time and money.
rungs.delivery: Owns operating strategy, cost and the company's resilience.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and is the executive team's right hand.
